Context: A. Seniority of Direct Recruits

## A. Seniority of Direct Recruits  
- 1.1. Determination of Seniority.-The seniority of direct recruits is based on the order of merit in which they are selected for appointment. Candidates selected earlier hold higher seniority than those selected later. The previous practice of determining seniority based on the date of confirmation has been discontinued 1 since November 4, 1992.
